note: The session's web search allowance ran out after the six judges, so everyone else was looked up only on pages whose address was already known or could be reached from a district's or city's own home page (board and council pages, the parties' own endorsement pages already named in the lean record, one campaign site linked from a party page). Not reached: the Governor's press releases on the two appointed judges (the state's site refuses scripts), Forest Hills Public Schools' board page (refuses scripts), Grand Rapids Public Schools (certificate error). Not found on their district's board page, so nothing recorded: Patricia Jones (Grand Blanc), D.L. Dye (Roseville), Katie Chittick (Berkley), Ginny Jeup (Grosse Pointe; the page lists no members to a script), DaNetta L. Simpson (Detroit). No campaign site was found for Kimberly L. Edwards, Brendan P. Leddy, Thomas Ryan, Jerry Neyer or Walter Willis. A blank here means not looked up or not found, not that nothing exists.
